name: hly-codex-guards
description: HLY cross-cutting engineering guardrails for evidence-based investigation, bounded modification scope, SQL, logging, Chinese comments, code correctness review, single-risk fixes, and Subagent usage boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Engineering guardrails for review, SQL, logging, comments, and fixes
interface.longDescription: Personal cross-cutting engineering guardrails for evidence-based investigation, bounded modification scope, code correctness review, simple maintainable SQL, minimal valuable logging, restrained Chinese business comments, single-risk fixes, and Subagent usage boundaries. Feature lifecycle, stage management, context handoff, and execution orchestration remain outside this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use $code-review-guard to review only the current diff.
Use $single-risk-fix to fix one confirmed risk with the smallest change.
Use $subagent-delegation-assessment to assess whether delegation has clear net benefit and respects the original task scope.
